name: wispr-pm
description: Run your task boards by voice. Dictate with Wispr Flow: "park this for the portfolio", "what's next on nailinit", "split this into tasks", "start a thread for the hero fix", "what's waiting on me". One board per project (your Switchboard board where it exists), Claude Code threads per card, decisions as small numbered cards, waiting-on-you at the notch.
